# Sleep tracking

Tracking sleep with the watch since March. What actually changed the numbers:

- No coffee after 2 pm: deep sleep up by about 20 minutes.
- Bedroom at 18 °C instead of 22 °C: fewer wake-ups.
- Alcohol, even one beer, raises the resting heart rate for the whole night.
- Screens off at 10 pm is the hardest one to keep.

Average sleep in March 6 h 40 min, in May 7 h 15 min. The tracking itself is only useful if I look at weekly averages, not single nights.
